title: Lew's extremal characterization conjecture for simplicial complexes
statement:
Let $X$ be a simplicial complex on vertex set $V$ of size $n$, with $h(X)=d$. Write $\mu_k(X)$ for the parameter appearing in the equality below, and let $\Delta_m$ denote the complete simplicial complex on $m+1$ vertices; $\Delta_d^{(d-1)}$ is its $(d-1)$-dimensional skeleton. The symbol $*$ denotes the join of simplicial complexes, and $X\cong Y$ means that $X$ and $Y$ are isomorphic simplicial complexes. **Lew's conjecture.** If

$$
\mu_k(X)=(d+1)(k+1)-dn
$$

for some $k$, then

$$
X\cong \left(\Delta_d^{(d-1)}\right)^{*(n-k-1)}*\Delta_{(d+1)(k+1)-dn-1}.
$$

In particular, $\dim(X)=k$. Lew proposed this as a characterization of the simplicial complexes attaining equality in the relevant spectral-gap lower bound; the supplied source does not state whether the conjecture has been resolved.
source_name: Xiongfeng Zhan, Xueyi Huang and Huiqiu Lin, “Proof of Lew's conjecture on the spectral gaps of simplicial complexes”, arXiv:2407.10398 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.10398

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2024).
